mapper.select: SELECT rpj.id AS pj_id, rpj.program_id AS pj_program_id, rpj.job_position_id AS pj_job_position_id, rpj.is_enabled AS pj_is_enabled, rpj.bonus_amount AS pj_bonus_amount, rpj.tag AS pj_tag, rpj.job_title AS pj_job_title, rpj.min_salary AS pj_min_salary, rpj.max_salary AS pj_max_salary, rpj.head_count AS pj_head_count, rp.title AS program_title, rp.description AS program_description, rp.bonus_amount AS program_bonus_amount, rp.bonus_structure AS program_bonus_structure, rp.start_date AS program_start_date, rp.end_date AS program_end_date, rp.status AS program_status, rp.create_by AS program_create_by, rjp.title AS job_title, rjp.job_description AS job_description, rjp.responsibilities AS job_responsibilities, rjp.requirements AS job_requirements, rjp.skills AS job_skills, rjp.min_salary AS job_min_salary, rjp.max_salary AS job_max_salary, rjp.work_location AS job_location, rjp.position_type AS job_position_type, rjp.experience_level AS job_experience_level, rjp.education_level AS job_education_level, rjp.status AS job_status, rjp.department_id AS job_department_id, d.dept_name AS job_department_name, rjp.id AS job_id FROM ref_program_job rpj LEFT JOIN ref_program rp ON rpj.program_id = rp.id LEFT JOIN smart_recruit_recruitment.rec_job_position rjp ON rpj.job_position_id = rjp.id LEFT JOIN smart_recruit_system.sys_department d ON rjp.department_id = d.id WHERE rpj.id = #{programJobId}
